paragraphs.text: Many cities that removed their tram lines in the middle of the twentieth century are now building new ones. The old trams were often seen as slow and noisy, and buses, which did not need rails, appeared more flexible.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The modern tram is a very different vehicle. It is quiet, has low floors that make it easy to board with a pushchair or wheelchair, and can carry more than three times as many passengers as a bus.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Supporters also point to its effect on property. In several French cities, the value of homes and shops near new tram stops rose faster than in other areas, and some businesses moved specifically to be close to the line.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Trams are not cheap, however. Laying the track means digging up streets and moving pipes and cables, and a single kilometre can cost many times more than a bus lane. Construction may disrupt traffic and local shops for several years.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: For this reason some cities have chosen a compromise: buses that run in their own lanes and stop at raised platforms, offering some of the comfort of a tram at a fraction of the cost. Critics argue that these lanes are easily taken over by other traffic when budgets are cut.
paragraphs.label: E

paragraphs.text: Perhaps the strongest argument for trams is psychological. Because the rails are permanent, residents and investors trust that the service will still be there in twenty years, which is not true of a bus route that can be changed overnight.
paragraphs.label: F

items.quote: The old trams were often seen as slow and noisy, and buses, which did not need rails, appeared more flexible
items.prompt: a reason why trams were removed in the past

explanation.en: Why trams were removed: “The old trams were often seen as slow and noisy”, while buses seemed more flexible → A.
explanation.kk: Трамвайларды неге алып тастағаны: «The old trams were often seen as slow and noisy», ал автобустар икемдірек көрінген → A.
explanation.ru: Почему трамваи убирали: «The old trams were often seen as slow and noisy», а автобусы казались гибче → A.

items.quote: can carry more than three times as many passengers as a bus
items.prompt: a comparison of how many people different vehicles can carry

explanation.en: “can carry more than three times as many passengers as a bus” — a comparison of tram and bus capacity → B.
explanation.kk: «can carry more than three times as many passengers as a bus» — трамвай мен автобустың сыйымдылығын салыстыру → B.
explanation.ru: «can carry more than three times as many passengers as a bus» — сравнение вместимости трамвая и автобуса → B.

items.quote: these lanes are easily taken over by other traffic when budgets are cut
items.prompt: the risk that a cheaper alternative may not be protected in future

explanation.en: The cheaper alternative is buses in their own lanes; critics fear the lanes are “easily taken over by other traffic when budgets are cut” → E. Paragraph D is about tram costs, not the alternative’s risks.
explanation.kk: Арзан балама — өз жолағындағы автобус; сыншылар жолақтар «easily taken over by other traffic when budgets are cut» деп қауіптенеді → E. D абзацы баламаның қаупі туралы емес, трамвай бағасы туралы.
explanation.ru: Дешёвая альтернатива — автобусы на своих полосах; критики боятся, что полосы «easily taken over by other traffic when budgets are cut» → E. Абзац D говорит о цене трамвая, а не о рисках альтернативы.

items.quote: Because the rails are permanent, residents and investors trust that the service will still be there in twenty years
items.prompt: the idea that permanent infrastructure makes people feel confident

explanation.en: The last paragraph explains why rails build confidence: “Because the rails are permanent, residents and investors trust that the service will still be there”. Confidence = “trust” → F.
explanation.kk: Соңғы абзац рельстің неге сенім тудыратынын түсіндіреді: «Because the rails are permanent, residents and investors trust that the service will still be there». Сенімділік — «trust» → F.
explanation.ru: Последний абзац объясняет, почему рельсы внушают доверие: «Because the rails are permanent, residents and investors trust that the service will still be there». Уверенность — это «trust» → F.

items.quote: Construction may disrupt traffic and local shops for several years
items.prompt: the problems caused while tram lines are being built

explanation.en: Streets are dug up, and “Construction may disrupt traffic and local shops for several years” → D.
explanation.kk: Құрылыс кезінде көшелер қазылады, «Construction may disrupt traffic and local shops for several years» → D.
explanation.ru: При строительстве улицы раскапывают, а «Construction may disrupt traffic and local shops for several years» → D.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. The reading passage has six paragraphs, A–F. Which paragraph contains the following information? Write the correct letter, A–F.
